# Constantinteck

> Food brand by Constantin: easy recipes from his Instagram, TikTok and YouTube videos, and kitchen aprons designed by his mom and sewn by hand in Germany.

Every recipe on this site is the written version of one of Constantin's videos (Instagram, TikTok and YouTube: @constantinteck): ingredients with quantities, numbered steps, time and servings, as plain text. The site is in English. Prices are in euros; no VAT is charged (small-business rule, § 19 UStG). Contact: info@constantinteck.com

## Main pages

- [All recipes](https://constantinteck.com/recipes.html): Every recipe from my videos: no-churn sorbets, smoothies, chia puddings and quick pasta dinners. Search by ingredient, filter by time and difficulty.
- [Shop](https://constantinteck.com/shop.html): The waffle piqué aprons from my videos – one grown-up, one for kids, or both as a set for €69.90. Sewn by hand in Germany, shipped all over the world.
- [About Constantin](https://constantinteck.com/about.html): Constantin, 23, cooks for anyone who'll sit at the table and films it as @constantinteck. The aprons in the shop are designed by his mom and sewn in Germany.

## Recipe collections

- [No-churn sorbet & ice cream](https://constantinteck.com/collections/sorbet-and-ice-cream.html): Fruit sorbets and nice cream made in the blender: frozen fruit, a few more ingredients, no ice cream maker and no churning. Most take four ingredients.
- [Smoothies & smoothie bowls](https://constantinteck.com/collections/smoothies.html): Fruit smoothies and smoothie bowls from my videos: frozen fruit, milk or coconut milk, a little honey and one blender. Each one is ready in about 5 minutes.
- [Breakfast](https://constantinteck.com/collections/breakfast.html): Breakfasts to make ahead or blend in minutes: thick chia puddings that set in the fridge, smoothie bowls with granola and a quick strawberry smoothie.
- [Quick weeknight dinners](https://constantinteck.com/collections/weeknight-dinners.html): Dinners for busy weekdays: creamy pastas, a cheesy chicken wrap and spicy peanut udon – one pan or one tray, 20 to 35 minutes, nothing complicated.

## Recipes

- [Avocado Ice Cream](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/avocado-ice-cream.html): Avocado ice cream with fresh mint, honey and lemon juice: four ingredients, naturally sweet and creamy. Ready in 5 minutes in the blender, no churning.
- [Baba Ganoush](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/baba-ganoush.html): Baba ganoush from roasted eggplant: char the skin, then blend the flesh with garlic, tahini, lemon and olive oil. An easy vegan dip for 4, ready in 1 hour.
- [Blueberry Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/blueberry-sorbet.html): Blueberry sorbet from frozen blueberries and banana with a little sugar and lemon juice. Four ingredients, 5 minutes in the blender, a summer treat for 2.
- [Cheesy Roasted Chicken Wrap](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/cheesy-roasted-chicken-wrap.html): Chicken and peppers roast on one tray, then go into tortillas with melted cheese and a garlic yogurt sauce. An easy weeknight wrap for 2 in 35 minutes.
- [Chocolate Banana Ice Cream](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/chocolate-banana-ice-cream.html): Chocolate banana ice cream from frozen bananas, dark chocolate, yogurt and honey. Four ingredients, naturally sweet, ready in 5 minutes without churning.
- [Coconut Mango Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/coconut-mango-sorbet.html): Coconut mango sorbet: frozen mango and frozen coconut milk blended with lemon juice and honey. Only four ingredients and 5 minutes for a tropical dessert.
- [Creamy One-Pan Salmon Pasta](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/creamy-one-pan-salmon-pasta.html): Salmon, feta and cherry tomatoes bake in one dish until the feta melts into a creamy sauce, then the pasta goes in. An easy dinner for 2 in 35 minutes.
- [Creamy Roasted Red Pepper & Tomato Pasta](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/creamy-roasted-red-pepper-tomato-pasta.html): Peppers, cherry tomatoes and a whole garlic bulb roast on one tray, then blend with mozzarella into a creamy sauce. An easy pasta for 4 in 40 minutes.
- [Creamy Sucuk Carbonara](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/creamy-sucuk-carbonara.html): Carbonara with crispy sucuk: egg yolks, parmesan and the sucuk's own oil make the creamy sauce. Six ingredients, ready in 25 minutes, serves 4.
- [Dragon Fruit Smoothie](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/dragon-fruit-smoothie.html): Dragon fruit smoothie with frozen mango, coconut milk and a little honey. Four ingredients, one blender and 5 minutes for a bright tropical drink for 2.
- [Dragonfruit Mango Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/dragonfruit-mango-sorbet.html): Dragonfruit mango sorbet from four ingredients: frozen dragonfruit and mango, lemon juice and honey. Naturally sweet, straight from the blender in 5 minutes.
- [Fudgy Chocolate Raspberry Banana Bread](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/fudgy-chocolate-raspberry-banana-bread.html): Fudgy banana bread with dark chocolate and fresh raspberries, made with whole spelt flour and mixed in a single bowl. 10 servings, about 65 minutes in all.
- [Granola Berry Smoothie Bowl](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/granola-berry-smoothie-bowl.html): Smoothie bowl from frozen blueberries and strawberries, topped with fresh berries and crunchy granola. Creamy, fruity and ready in 5 minutes for 2 bowls.
- [Grape Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/grape-sorbet.html): Grape sorbet from frozen grapes, sugar and lemon juice, finished with fresh mint. Freeze the grapes overnight, then blend in three steps – 5 minutes' work.
- [Healthy Raspberry Chocolate Nice Cream](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/healthy-raspberry-chocolate-nice-cream.html): Raspberry chocolate nice cream from frozen banana, raspberries, dark chocolate and lemon juice. Creamy, naturally sweet, 5 minutes, no ice cream maker.
- [Kiwi Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/kiwi-sorbet.html): Kiwi sorbet from frozen kiwis and fresh passionfruit with a little sugar and lemon juice. Four ingredients, five quick steps, ready in 5 minutes for 2.
- [Lemon Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/lemon-sorbet.html): Lemon sorbet in seconds: frozen lemon, coconut milk, sugar and fresh mint in the blender. No churn, no fuss – four ingredients and 5 minutes for 2.
- [Mango Raspberry Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/mango-raspberry-sorbet.html): Mango raspberry sorbet from frozen mango and raspberries with lemon juice and honey. Four ingredients, naturally sweet and about a minute of actual work.
- [Mango x Passionfruit Smoothie](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/mango-passionfruit-smoothie.html): Mango passionfruit smoothie with banana and coconut milk, sweetened with a little honey. A tropical summer drink for 2, blended in 5 minutes.
- [Peach Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/peach-sorbet.html): Peach sorbet from frozen peaches and orange juice with a little sugar and lemon, blended until creamy. Four ingredients, 5 minutes, no ice cream maker.
- [Peanut Spicy Udon](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/peanut-spicy-udon.html): Spicy peanut udon: noodles in a creamy peanut butter, soy and chilli sauce with garlic, scallions and coriander. One pan, 20 minutes, serves 2.
- [Pineapple Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/pineapple-sorbet.html): Pineapple sorbet with frozen mango, sugar and fresh lemon juice. Everything goes into the blender for about 30 seconds – a tropical treat in 5 minutes.
- [Strawberry Passion Fruit Smoothie](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/strawberry-passion-fruit-smoothie.html): Strawberry passion fruit smoothie from frozen strawberries, passion fruit pulp, milk and honey. No added sugar, four ingredients, 5 minutes for 2.
- [Strawberry Pineapple Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/strawberry-pineapple-sorbet.html): Strawberry pineapple sorbet from frozen strawberries and pineapple with lemon juice and a little sugar. Four ingredients, fruity, ready in 5 minutes.
- [Strawberry Smoothie](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/strawberry-smoothie.html): Creamy strawberry smoothie with banana, milk and a little honey. Four ingredients and 5 minutes – perfect for breakfast or as a sweet snack for 2.
- [Strawberry Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/strawberry-sorbet.html): Strawberry sorbet from frozen strawberries, lemon juice, sugar and fresh mint, blended in five short steps. Four ingredients and 5 minutes for 2.
- [Thick Blueberry Chia Pudding](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/thick-blueberry-chia-pudding.html): Thick blueberry chia pudding with yogurt, milk and honey: blended in 10 minutes, then set in the fridge for 4 hours. For breakfast, dessert or a snack.
- [Thick Mango Chia Pudding](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/thick-mango-chia-pudding.html): Thick mango chia pudding from one ripe mango, coconut milk, yogurt and honey. 10 minutes in the blender, 4 hours in the fridge – serves 2.
- [Thick Raspberry Chia Pudding](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/thick-raspberry-chia-pudding.html): Thick raspberry chia pudding with coconut milk, yogurt and honey. Fresh or frozen raspberries, 10 minutes of work and 4 hours in the fridge, serves 2.
- [Yellow Watermelon Sorbet](https://constantinteck.com/recipes/yellow-watermelon-sorbet.html): Yellow watermelon sorbet with honey, lemon and fresh mint. An easy four-ingredient summer dessert straight from the blender in 5 minutes, serves 2.

- [Apron set »Dough Love« (adult + kids)](https://constantinteck.com/shop/apron-set.html): Both aprons from my videos in one parcel – the grown-up one and the small one – for €9.90 less than buying them apart. Waffle piqué, sewn in Germany.
